//: aocd configuration. Copy to aoc.config.json where you start aocd, or point --config <file> / AOC_CONFIG at it. Every key is optional and the values below are the built-in defaults. Relative paths resolve against this file's directory (~ is your home). Keys starting with // are comments; a //key shows an optional setting without enabling it. Env overrides: AOC_PORT, AOC_HOST, AOC_DATA_DIR, AOC_PUBLIC_URL. Secrets never go here: see .env.example.
//mode: production refuses to start unless managed sessions are isolated (supervisor.sessionUser + readOnlySessionUser, aocd as root) and the KEK comes from keys.masterKeyFile (outside dataDir, 0400/0600, owned by aocd's user; never AOC_MASTER_KEY, never generated). See docs/runbooks/credential-isolation.md §4.
//publicUrl: https://aoc.example.com — the origin browsers use (links, WebAuthn). Defaults to http://localhost:<port>; set it when aocd sits behind a proxy or TLS.

keys.//: Key-encryption key for the per-scope body keys (crypto-shred, §13). Development order: AOC_MASTER_KEY env, then masterKeyFile, else <dataDir>/master.key is generated (0600). Production mode accepts only an existing masterKeyFile outside the data dir, per docs/runbooks/key-custody.md (R6).

supervisor.//: Managed claude sessions. sidecar/hook/mcp commands are filled in by aocd: dist/bin/aoc-*.mjs next to the aocd bundle, else the package sources via tsx. Only envAllowlist variables reach a session; deploy credentials live solely in the credential profiles file (§3).
supervisor.//credentialProfilesFile: /etc/aoc/credential-profiles.json — { "profiles": { "<name>": { "env": { "GIT_SSH_COMMAND": "ssh -i {{file:ssh-key}}" }, "files": { "ssh-key": "/etc/aoc/keys/<name>" } } } }, readable only by the user aocd runs as; never on developer machines. Isolated sessions get a private copy of each file for the length of a turn.
supervisor.//isolation: user | none. Unset: user once sessionUser is set or in production, else none (sessions run as aocd's own user and can read its keys and databases: development only, warned on every launch).
supervisor.//sessionUser: aoc-agent — unprivileged OS user every credentialed turn runs as (claude, hooks, MCP server, tools). aocd must run as root to switch to it.
supervisor.//readOnlySessionUser: aoc-reader — OS user for read-only (triage) types, with its own uid and group; required in production.
supervisor.//runner: Optional argv prefix that starts each turn in its isolated context instead of a direct uid/gid switch (a per-session container wrapper, or ["setpriv","--reuid={uid}","--regid={gid}","--clear-groups","--"]). Placeholders: {user} {uid} {gid} {sessionId} {sessionDir} {cwd}.

decisions.//soleApproverFallback: Off by CEO decision: with one Approver, their own requests wait for a second Approver (never credit top-ups).
decisions.//webhookUrl: https://hooks.example.com/aoc — opt-in notification for new and aging decisions (R15).

fx.//: Daily USD→MYR from BNM: extract with Haiku, escalate once to Sonnet, else carry forward (flagged). extractor: claude-cli | anthropic-sdk (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) | fake.

audit.//: Nightly off-host anchor of the chain head (§13, R2). git: one signed commit per anchor in a separate repo, ideally pushed off-host via anchorRemote; rfc3161: a timestamp from tsaUrl.

intake.//: End-user portal uploads (§7, R4). aocd accepts intake request bodies up to maxVideoBytes + 1 MiB; every other request body is capped at 1 MiB.

selfModification.//: Repos that are AOC itself; changes under protectedPaths (governance, audit, credit core) are refused to agents and logged outside AOC (§13).

identity.//: WebAuthn relying party. origin and rpId default to publicUrl's origin and hostname.
identity.//bootstrapTokenFile: .aoc/bootstrap.token — one-time token for the first Approver (printed once by `aoc init`); AOC_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN works too.
